summary.title: Online Store Scheme
summary.description: Threat model lengkap untuk aplikasi manajemen toko online (threaddragon.com) dengan React Frontend, Node.js REST API Server, MySQL Database, Redis Cache, Email Service, dan Payment Gateway Integration (Midtrans/Xendit). Mencakup 9 ancaman STRIDE dengan 52 mitigasi dan 5 security requirements.

threats.title: Tampering Data Harga Produk
threats.description: Attacker dapat mengubah harga produk di frontend sebelum melakukan pembayaran
threats.mitigation:
Server-side Price Validation (WAJIB)
- Priority: Critical

Recalculate Total Price di Backend
- Priority: Critical

Digital Signature pada Order Data
- Priority: High

Database Audit Logging untuk Price Changes
- Priority: Medium

threats.title: Information Disclosure - Kebocoran Data Customer
threats.description: Attacker dapat mengakses data customer yang sensitive melalui API endpoint yang tidak ter-protect
threats.mitigation:
Encrypt Sensitive Data at Rest (AES-256)
- Priority: Critical

Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
- Priority: Critical

Data Masking pada API Responses
- Priority: High

Parameterized Queries (Prevent SQL Injection)
- Priority: Critical

Encrypt Database Backups
- Priority: High

threats.title: Denial of Service (DoS) - Server Overload
threats.description: Attacker dapat overload server dengan request volume tinggi
threats.mitigation:
1. Rate Limiting - 10 requests per minute per IP, exponential backoff - CRITICAL
2. CAPTCHA untuk Forms Sensitive - Google reCAPTCHA v3 atau hCaptcha - HIGH
3. DDoS Protection - CDN dengan built-in DDoS (CloudFlare, AWS CloudFront) - HIGH
4. Database Connection Pooling - limit 20-50 connections, timeout 30 seconds - HIGH
5. Request Queuing & Throttling - Bull queue, Redis-based queue - MEDIUM
6. Email Rate Limiting - max 5 emails per minute per user - MEDIUM
7. Web Application Firewall (WAF) - AWS WAF, ModSecurity, atau CloudFlare WAF - HIGH

threats.title: Elevation of Privilege - Unauthorized Admin Access
threats.description: Regular user dapat mengakses admin functions atau escalate privilege mereka
threats.mitigation:
1. JWT Role-Based Authorization
include role dalam JWT, verify di setiap endpoint - CRITICAL
2. Authorization Middleware
verify user role sebelum handler execute - CRITICAL
3. Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) untuk Admin
TOTP atau U2F key - CRITICAL
4. IP Whitelisting untuk Admin Panel
restrict ke office/VPN IP - HIGH
5. Audit Logging untuk Admin Actions
log CREATE, READ, UPDATE, DELETE - HIGH
6. Admin Session Timeout
15 menit inactivity, require re-authentication - MEDIUM
7. Principle of Least Privilege 
Super Admin, Product Manager, Order Manager roles - HIGH

Token Expiration (JWT: 30 menit)
- Priority: Critical

HttpOnly & Secure Cookie Storage
- Priority: Critical

Token Rotation Strategy
- Priority: High

CSRF Protection (SameSite=Strict)
- Priority: High

XSS Prevention & CSP Headers
- Priority: Critical
